capabilities: Create interactive task-tree maps with automatic layout in .taskmap files
Set Draft, Ready, In progress, and Done statuses, with parent statuses calculated from children
Mark blocker relationships between tasks that gate completion
Link tasks to vault notes that rename and move together with the task
Pan, zoom, collapse subtrees, reorder by dragging, and focus one subtree
disambiguation: Not a Markdown task or checkbox manager; tasks live in .taskmap JSON files and don't sync with checkboxes or task plugins.
extras: Desktop app only (no mobile). Obsidian Sync skips .taskmap files unless 'Sync all other types' is enabled on each device. The README states documentation is incomplete and lists planned features: text view, sync support, multi-select, mobile, and a standalone sharing website.
motivation: The author built it because large Kanban boards get hard to read; a color-coded tree shows done, in-progress, and ready tasks, blockers, and the goal-to-subtask breakdown at a glance.
problem: Large Kanban boards get hard to read, and Obsidian has no built-in hierarchical task view that lays itself out and shows status and blockers at a glance.
summary: Visual project planner that lays out tasks as an interactive, color-coded tree with statuses, blockers, and links to vault notes.
